newsitem.title: USA: Gunplay brings Christmas tragedy in Miami.
newsitem.headline: Gunplay brings Christmas tragedy in Miami.

text.p: A man was shot to death amid festivities in Miami's Little Havana after he complained to his step-daughter's boyfriend about his firing a gun to welcome in Christmas Day, police said.

Osberto Vargas, 42, drew his pistol and fired several times into the ground at midnight at a "Noche Buena" Christmas Eve party in the Cuban district, even though several children were nearby. He was thrown out of the party but the angry host, Joaquin Luz, followed Vargas to remonstrate with him further.
Vargas pulled out his reloaded gun and shot Luz six times in the head. He was arrested and charged with second degree murder, Lt. Bill Shartz said.
